spec.grid: the last 12 month-end decision sessions of each era; the same end is applied to all five arms and both books
spec.delta: screen arm level minus unscreened level on the SAME end
spec.zero_rule: an end reads zero when |delta| < 0.05bp, the precision the published E99 deltas are quoted at
spec.step_rule: step_signature when exactly one end of the grid is non-zero and it is the era's own last end

eras.skipped: fewer than 3 decision ends fall inside this era

answers.reads_as: the five published arms are 5 distinct end-grid measurements and 3 era-book cells in which four screen arms quote one identical delta: the family is a measurement of one transition under several names wherever the identity cells are the movers

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
all five arms share the panel calendar, the rank cache and the fee ladder; the arms are universe repairs, not different strategies

a zero-delta end is not a zero effect: the grid truncates the evaluation end and every end is priced through the next decision of the same book, so a transition sitting after the era's own last end can still be counted
identical deltas across gap1/gap2/gap5 mean the gap limit does not bind on this panel; it does not mean the three screens are the same object
the churn level is a name-level mean over swapped pairs, not a portfolio return: the deltas move a reading, not money
